format: Contract manifest; executable validators are frozen by source hash, not an external JSON Schema validator

decomposition.span_convention: Code derives zero-based exclusive offsets from unique exact quotes; absent/ambiguous/out-of-order/overlapping quotes are rejected
decomposition.coverage: All content words, quantities, units and conditions; no split token or inner AND predicate. A leading AND connector is allowed in a later part. A claim without English AND is represented by exactly one quote containing the complete claim.
decomposition.repair: At most 2 attempts; structural repair reports the related scope/coverage failures together. Syntax repair regenerates without replaying malformed JSON. Other errors include prior output, capped at 6000 characters.
decomposition.semantic_gate: 18 unique development claims; all structural checks AND human predicate/coverage/quantifier/entity-metric/time-condition review before full 39-case inference
decomposition.scope_rules: Copy capitalization exactly. Prefer the named measurement property in metric. Preserve entity population modifiers. Explicit simple temporal phrases require their full scope in time; simple on/using/under ... dataset restrictions belong in condition and cannot be stored in time. Semantic assignments outside these grammar rules require review.

assessment.truth_semantics: Positive predicate before applying the quantifier
assessment.complete_coverage: Quoted nonempty population with unique members and one observation per declared member

numeric.arithmetic: Source-grounded Decimal; value comparison or ordered before/after change
numeric.unknown_policy: No implicit unit conversion, unsupported comparisons or ambiguous association

result.aggregation: Per-quantifier part decisions, then AND across parts

decoding.adapter: Public TokenEnforcer core plus Transformers prefix_allowed_tokens_fn; default serving backend has no constraint kwargs
decoding.decomposition: Schema required keys/types/arrays; quote/scope enum from exact word-boundary spans in current claim; unique quotes; unambiguous quantifier restricted by source wording; no-AND claims require exactly one complete quote; detected simple temporal/dataset scope limits field enums
decoding.assessment: Schema required fields/types, scope_match/truth/numeric enums and nullable numeric object; exact evidence and arithmetic still validated after generation
decoding.trace: Every generation records decoder policy and schema SHA256; missing/mismatched trace fails gate
decoding.scope_limit: At most 80 whitespace-separated claim words for finite source enums
decoding.limitations: Schema validity does not prove atomicity, correct scope or entailment; truncated output still fails validation; human review required; supported scope grammar is English AND and simple temporal/dataset phrases; whole no-AND quote does not prove semantic atomicity
